description: This file defines the Layout class within the OpenCart Admin Controller for the design layout management. It handles listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting layout configurations in the admin interface, including generating URLs, loading models, and rendering views.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Controller class for managing layout configurations in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry to load the layout management page, setting up breadcrumbs, URLs, and loading the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Loads the list of layouts by rendering getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of layouts with pagination, sorting, and links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a layout, including loading default data, extensions, modules, and layout routes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (creating or updating) a layout based on POST data, with permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected layouts after permission check and validating no dependencies or default layouts are affected.
